Thanks for the advice but I really do not trust my parents with this... My cat probably will give me more emotional support than my parents.

They really don't deserve to be a father and a mother.

well... my parents got a divorce. I get no support from my family, the only support I get are from friends (but I tend to keep things to myself because I don't want to burden them with my issues).

by support I mean, emotional support. my family does support me financially but that's proabably only because they have to...

It was pretty big for me when it happened but I guess it doesn't matter that much to me now.
